notes.title: Yuri Cyberpunk Thriller Synergia has been released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's been a long time coming, but we are proud to announce that Synergia is finally live! After 4 years, the game is finally out. Synergia is a unique cyberpunk yuri thriller, wrapped up in a neon artstyle.

One android's fate may spell the difference between peace, war, the blossoming of a new religion, or a technological singularity beyond comprehension.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1047010/Synergia/

The game features over 100+ unique CGs & BGs, multiple endings, and up to an estimated 10+ hours of gameplay. Also includes steam achievements! The game will run a 10% discount for the week of its release.

notes.title: New Uncensored Release - Yuri Visual Novel, Forest Guardian!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12668505/98ca23738fb545bc6ba53290456631cb03427e99.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

This is a quick update, just dropping in to let everyone know we've rolled out a new release, a fantasy yuri visual novel entitled "Forest Guardian". It's [b]completely uncensored[/b] and features around 5~ hours of gameplay and around 20 CGs. It also features foxgirls! It runs at $10.99, but will have a 10% discount for the next week.

Pick it up here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1181030/Forest_Guardian

notes.title: 简体中文已更新！- Now Available in Simplified Chinese!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

While it has been awhile since our last update, we are very happy to say that the game is now available in Simplified Chinese in addition to Russian and English. In order to switch to Chinese, under the "Settings" tab on the main menu, there is now an option to switch to Simplified Chinese.

---------------------------------------------

大家好，
距离我们上次更新已经有一段时间了，我们很高兴地宣布除了俄文和英文外，我们也将提供简体中文语言支持。请在主菜单的“设定”页面里切换到中文。

notes.title: 1/19 Update - Fixes & Improvements!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We hope you are all enjoying the game. We've just rolled out a new patch, which features a lot of tweaks, improvements, and small fixed to various things in the game; you can read a full list of changes below.

[list]
[*] Gallery Feature Added 
[*] The "H" key can now be used to hide the text box 
[*] Improvements to English translation - typo fixes & various language improvements
[*] Restored missing text strings in certain scenes
[*] Fixed certain UI buttons using wrong language counterparts
[*] Small quality and engine improvements and fixes
[/list]

That's all for now! Thank you to everyone who supported the game and continues to do so - we all really appreciate it!
